title: MyLang project file
description: mylang.json: what `mylang init` writes, what `mylang install` reads, and the settings of `mylang prettier`.

name.description: Package name: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

version.description: Version of this package, as semver.

main.description: Entry file, relative to this file. Must end with .ml.

initScript.description: A .ml file run before the program, whose declarations become globals. Names it defines belong in the `mylang.globals` setting so the editor does not report them as undefined.

dependencies.description: Packages this project imports, as `name: "Owner:repo"`. Installed into `.module` by `mylang install`.

prettier.description: Settings of `mylang prettier` (MyLang2 2.3), used by the formatter in this editor as well. An unknown name or an impossible value is an error, never silently ignored.

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

printWidth.description: Lines longer than this are broken at the commas of a bracket that opens and closes on them. 0 never breaks a line.

quote.description: Preferred quote. The other one is used for a string that would need fewer escapes with it; "preserve" leaves every string as written.

bracketSpacing.description: Spaces just inside the braces of an object literal: `{ a: 1 }` against `{a: 1}`.

maxBlankLines.description: Blank lines kept in a row. None are kept at the edges of a block.

finalNewline.description: End the file with a newline.

include.description: Globs the formatter walks when it is given a folder.
